err.default: That did not work. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the owner.
err.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is missing or not valid: {fields}.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — it may have been changed. Reload the page.
err.DUPLICATE: A courier account with this name exists already.
err.UNKNOWN_PROVIDER: The shop has no connection for this courier.
err.NO_ZONE_LIST: This courier publishes no area list: it reads the address itself.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You are signed out. Sign in again.
err.NOT_PRINTABLE: Some stickers cannot be printed now: {fields}. Untick them, or re-book the parcel first.
err.popup: The PDF is ready but the browser blocked the new tab. It was downloaded instead.
err.REASON_REQUIRED: These stickers were printed before: say why they are printed again.
err.NOTHING_TO_HAND_OVER: Nothing is ready to hand over to this courier: {fields}. Print the stickers first, or re-book a parcel that changed.
err.ALREADY_HANDED_OVER: This batch was marked handed over already. Reload the page.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.sub: Each courier account, its mode, and its own list of areas paired with the shop's.
couriers.empty: No courier account yet. Add one: it runs on its practice mode until the courier's keys are entered in Keys & connections.
couriers.noList: Reads the address itself — no area list to pair.
couriers.readQueued: Asked: the list is read in the background within the hour.
couriers.readDone: Done: the list is read and paired.
couriers.running: Being read: {calls} questions asked so far, {left} left.
couriers.practiceNote: Practice mode: nothing leaves the server; the practice list is a sample, not the courier's real one.

courier.stats: {city} cities · {zone} zones · {area} areas · {paired} paired by name · {unclear} unclear names
courier.statsDropped: {places} places and {pairs} pairs archived (the courier dropped them) · {restored} came back
courier.failed: The courier did not answer: {error}. Nothing was archived; read again later.
courier.candidates: Same name in the courier's list:
courier.noCandidate: No courier place with this name. Find one below.
courier.unpairAsk: Take this pair away? Parcels to this area then use the area above it, or wait for a new pair.
courier.droppedNote: The courier no longer lists {place}. The pair is kept for the record and comes back if the courier lists it again.
courier.emptyNeeded: No parcel is waiting for an area of this courier.
courier.emptyMapped: No area is paired yet. Press "Read the list now".
courier.emptyDropped: The courier has not dropped any paired place.
courier.noListLong: This courier publishes no area list: it reads the receiver's address itself, so nothing needs pairing.

packing.printSub: Courier stickers for every booked parcel still with us, in packing order: the category and style with the most pieces first. A sticker printed again is marked REPRINT.
packing.settingsNote: Size, printer dots, language and the exact-amount line are delivery settings (Delivery → More options).
packing.more: {n} more wait for the next print (up to {max} per print).
packing.emptySub: A parcel appears here once a courier is booked, and leaves when it is handed over or the courier picks it up.

problem.NOT_READY: order not ready (on hold or moved on)

sample.name: Sample Receiver
sample.address: House, road, area, district (the address prints in full here)

reprint.label: Why print it again?
reprint.short: Write a short reason (at least 3 letters).
reprint.ask: Printed before: {orders}. Write why, then press Print again. It stays the same parcel.

handover.title: Handover
handover.sub: The parcels to give each courier's rider: booked, still with us, sticker printed. Print the sheet, let the rider tick and sign it, then mark it handed over.
handover.settingsNote: Paper, printer dots, language, names, signatures and "mark packed" are delivery settings (Delivery → More options).
handover.openBatch: Sheet printed ×{n} with {parcels} parcels, started {at}. Not handed over yet.
handover.emptySub: A parcel appears here once it is booked and its sticker printed, and leaves when it is handed over.

sheet.title: Handover sheet · {courier}
sheet.again: PRINTED AGAIN ({n}) — the same parcels, not new ones
